description: Nucleoid keeps vertically separated readings reactive
code:
seed = 2
readings = [
    seed
    seed + 1
    seed * 2
]
assert(readings, [2, 3, 4])
assert(readings.length, 3)
assert(readings[0], 2)
seed = 5
assert(readings, [5, 6, 10])
assert(readings.length, 3)
assert(readings[2], 10)
1

description: Nucleoid keeps nested rows reactive with unambiguous newline separators
code:
seed = 2
rows = [
    [
        seed
        seed + 1
    ],
    [
        seed * 2
        seed * 3
    ]
]
assert(rows[0], [2, 3])
assert(rows[1], [4, 6])
assert(rows.length, 2)
seed = 4
assert(rows[0], [4, 5])
assert(rows[1], [8, 12])
assert(rows[1].length, 2)
1
